picks.file: A View of Newcastle Upon Tyne.jpg
picks.what: View across the River Tyne with keelboats, colored aquatint
picks.who: Charles Muss, engraved by Joseph Constantine Stadler
picks.why: general view of the riverside town with church spires and the old Tyne Bridge; dated plate

picks.what: St. Nicholas Cathedral, photochrom print (Library of Congress)
picks.why: color; the cathedral’s lantern tower with the castle keep behind; no general view for P4

picks.what: The Black Gate and the castle keep, postcard
picks.why: the city’s namesake castle; trolleybus wires (from 1935) and ‘pre-WWII’ date fix it to the late 1930s

picks.what: The Tyne bridges and the quayside, photograph
picks.why: Millennium Bridge, Tyne Bridge and skyline together; the city’s signature view

notes: #2 caption strip and gray border trimmed; #4 postcard caption trimmed. #4 date is inferred from the trolleybus wires and the ‘Pre WW II’ date field.
